history.summary: A 1,820 sqft 4BR in a 25-unit freehold boutique block at Telok Kurau, asking $2.88M ($1,582 psf). The large unit dilutes PSF but the tiny development is structurally illiquid and the $2.88M quantum sits in a thin buyer band for a no-facilities boutique.
history.rating_rationale: The Ambra is only 25 units (confirmed) — a boutique with no real facilities and almost no transaction depth (URA txn count = 6, resale CAGR ~5.2% off a tiny sample is unreliable). Listed PSF $1,582 is below district median $1,727, but that discount reflects the oversized layout and boutique illiquidity, not value. At $2.88M the buyer pool is narrow and exit risk is the dominant concern for a 5-7yr investment hold.
red_flags: Boutique 25-unit development — illiquid, no facilities, shallow buyer pool
URA txn count of 6 makes the ~5.2% resale rate statistically unreliable
$2.88M quantum is niche for a low-amenity boutique
8 min walk to MRT, not a transit-adjacent advantage
catalysts: Freehold tenure with East Coast / D15 lifestyle desirability
Large 1,820 sqft layout appeals to a thin own-stay family segment
